screens.title: Screens
screens.description: Configure screens for different display purposes. Each screen type has its own layout and configuration options.
screens.noScreensDescription: Add your first screen to configure how content is displayed.
screens.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

editor.previewTextDescription: Customize the preview text to test how your styling looks with different content.
editor.selectHint: Click a text on the preview to change its font, size and place.
editor.forSlideTypeDescription: These change only this slide type. Pick another one at the top.
editor.wholeScreenDescription: These are the same on every slide type of this screen.
editor.elementsHint: Pick one to change its font, size and place.

position.stretchHorizontal: Width stretches between left and right constraints
position.stretchVertical: Height stretches between top and bottom constraints
position.copied: Position copied. Paste it on another element, slide type or screen.
position.lockHint: Lock it so it can't be moved by mistake
position.unlockHint: Unlock to move or resize it
position.lockedDescription: The position is locked. Unlock it to move or resize the element.

textStyle.autoScaleDescription: Automatically scales text to fit the container. When disabled, uses a fixed font size.
textStyle.fitLineToWidthDescription: Prevents line wrapping - each line scales to fit container width

animation.slideTransitionOutDescription: Animation for old content leaving when changing slides
animation.slideTransitionInDescription: Animation for new content entering when changing slides

background.deleteConfirm: The file is removed from the app. Screens that still use it show their base color instead.

hint.any: Images: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 50 MB. Videos: MP4 (H.264) or WebM, up to 1 GB — these play on Windows, macOS and Linux.

background.songTypesHint: Songs use three layouts. Set the same background for {{song}}, {{firstSlide}} and {{lastSlide}}.
background.switchedType: The background type is now “{{type}}”, to match the uploaded file.
background.noViewPermission: You don't have permission to see the uploaded images and videos.

heavyGif.message_one: This GIF may play choppy or freeze on the screens: long animated GIFs are heavy to play. For a smooth background, convert it to an MP4 (H.264) or WebM video — for example with a GIF-to-MP4 converter — and upload the video instead.
heavyGif.message_other: These GIFs may play choppy or freeze on the screens: long animated GIFs are heavy to play. For a smooth background, convert them to MP4 (H.264) or WebM videos — for example with a GIF-to-MP4 converter — and upload the videos instead.

errors.unsupportedType: This file type isn't supported. Use a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF image, or an MP4 or WebM video.
errors.fileTooLarge: This file is too large. Images can be up to 50 MB and videos up to 1 GB.
errors.uploadFailed: The upload failed. Please try again.
errors.deleteFailed: The file could not be deleted. Please try again.
errors.loadFailed: The list of uploaded files could not be loaded.

unavailable.hint: It is on the church computer
